Payment on delivery and installation

No payment is taken on this website and no card details are collected here. We confirm the system and the site with you, book a time, and you pay once the unit is delivered and installed.

Your order total is shown in the summary. If the site needs more than a same-location swap, we confirm the difference with you before any work is booked.
